site.source_description: Hypothetical Cs-137 boundary projection using the brine composition in USGS PHREEQC Example 14
site.data_provenance: water composition transcribed from an official USGS PHREEQC example; source term and transport are demonstration inputs

provenance.water: USGS PHREEQC Example 14, Central Oklahoma aquifer, initial brine composition (Ca 0.4655, Mg 0.1609, Na 5.402, Cl 6.642 mol/kgw; C and S as published)
provenance.cec: USGS Example 14 estimates 1.0 exchange equivalent per liter of pore water; converted here with rho_b=2700 kg/m3 and porosity=0.22 for a transparent screening projection
provenance.selectivity: Na/Ca/Mg exchange coefficients follow the PHREEQC Gaines-Thomas database convention; Cs log K=1.2 is a demonstration placeholder requiring calibration against Cs multication experiments

query: Project a K-free, Na-Ca-Mg multicomponent groundwater composition into the Cs exchange bridge and report ion-specific exchange occupancy without replacing the canonical screening model.
